title: The Good Docs Project template types v1.0
description: Constrains `type` to the 25 template slugs published by The Good Docs Project (upstream templates repo, main as of 2026-08-09). Like Diataxis it classifies what a page *is*, so the two claim the same key and cannot be stacked — pick one. It composes with a schema keyed on a different field, such as passo-uno:seven-action:1.0. Vocabulary only: `type` is not required, so this checks that a type is legitimate, not that one is present. See https://www.thegooddocsproject.dev/template

type.description: Which Good Docs Project template this page follows, as the template's slug. The Core pack is `concept`, `how-to`, `readme`, `reference`, `release-notes`, `troubleshooting`, and `tutorial`; the rest come from the Community and Misc packs.
